answer: During each epoch, a rotating tide of peer attestations randomly reviews newcomers; fake identities would need to sustain genuine labor and stake across many accounts. Each new agent must stake a bond that unlocks only after completing a verified work history tracked on a public ledger, like a vine that must grow prior to bearing fruit. Duplicate registrations are detected by shared device fingerprints and flagged into a quarantine lagoon, making mass sybil creation costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
